name: Huntr
tagline: Huntr is a job search tracker that organizes your applications into a Kanban-style board with stages from wishlist to offer. Job seekers use it to keep track of where they applied, upcoming interviews, and follow-ups without losing details across email threads. AI tools help tailor resumes and cover letters to specific job descriptions, and the chrome extension captures job listings from any site.
